proposal.system_component: ToolGateway lifecycle in the multi-agent host control-plane
proposal.problem: When a second headless host boots with an already-active home, ToolGateway.start removes and rebinds the shared tools.sock; the first host remains visible but its new agent sessions cannot reach the tool gateway.
proposal.planned_change: Add a deterministic two-host socket-owner regression; then implement a minimal safe start and stop ownership check so a duplicate host refuses startup without replacing or removing the first host's socket.
proposal.expected_improvement: Prevent tool access loss for running first-host agent sessions when a duplicate host is launched; surface a useful duplicate-home diagnostic instead of silently breaking agent tools.
proposal.validation: Reproduce HarnessDesk issue 1772 on development, run node test with real gateway under packages/server/test, pnpm check:push and full relevant upstream CI; verify normal single-host restart and stale socket behavior.
